verdict.rationale: The official CLI supports crawling (same-domain, sitemap, or Scrapy spider), exports, and cron-based schedules, which together allow multi-page and multi-item operations. The API exposes concurrency usage, so parallel requests are an expected pattern. However, the core HTML API is documented as one URL per call, and schedules are a gated advanced feature, so bulk work mainly runs through the CLI or client-side fan-out. Missing for 10: a documented batch/bulk endpoint for submitting many URLs or items in one job, documentation of bulk input formats and result aggregation, and hands-on corroboration of bulk runs.
